CENTENNIAL CELEBRATION OF NIJNI-NOVGOROD'S FAMUS
FAIR TO BE HONORSED WITH PRESENCE OF RUSSIAN ROYALTY.

Nijni-Nevgorod's world-famous fair will celebrate its 100th anniversary in July. The session will be one of the most gorgeous that ever startled the eyes of the visitors to the "market of all nations."

The fair is an institution which antsdates the Russian history since in the ninth and tenth centur- ies it had long been flourishing on the left bank of the River Volga at its mouth right opposite to the great city of Itil on the right bank.

The most interesting feature to visitors is its fur marketvaluable pelts being brought from the furthest corners of Asia. The fair itself is of both stons and wood, Alexander L in 1823 having turned over to the local authorities a sum of 3,000,000 rubles, an amount he had set aside to build a winter place at Petrograd.

The reigning Russian family has always taken a warm interest in the Fair and it is almost certain that if the Emperor and some of the Grand Duches do not attend at least some of the Grand Duches will represent the house of Romancff at the celebration.
The fair itself lasts about three months or a little longer. During this time over 490,000,000 rubles change hands in the great trading centre.
